# ⚖️ Bangladesh Legal, Regulatory & Tax Framework

> **Governance Scope**: ICT Act 2006 &middot; Income Tax Act 2023 &middot; Data Protection & Consumer Rights  
> **Applicable Region**: Bangladesh (BD) & South Asian Trade Mesh  

---

## 1. Information & Communication Technology (ICT) Act 2006 Compliance

### Section 6 & 7: Digital Signatures & Ricardian Smart Contracts
* **Legal Recognition**: Electronic records and digital signatures generated by Shothik have full legal admissibility in Bangladeshi courts.
* **PKI Architecture**: When merchant twins sign B2B consignment contracts or procurement agreements, Shothik embeds SHA-256 asymmetric cryptographic keys.
* **Bilingual Requirement**: Contracts are generated in dual Bengali & English columns to satisfy contract enforcement standards under the **Contract Act 1872**.

---

## 2. Income Tax Act 2023 (National Board of Revenue — NBR)

### Section 163: Minimum Tax on Business Turnover
* Shothik's Tax Advisor Agent audits merchant revenue against the progressive gross receipts tax:
  - 0.6% on gross business turnover for general trading.
  - 0.1% for textile & RMG export manufacturers.
* **SRO Gazette Citation Engine**: Tax recommendations must quote verbatim National Board of Revenue (NBR) Statutory Regulatory Orders (SROs).

### Section 89: Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) on Creator Marketplace Splits
* For the **80/20 Creator Economy** marketplace:
  - 10% TDS is deducted at source on author/creator royalties exceeding ৳25,000/year.
  - Shothik auto-generates Form 23 TDS withholding certificates for creators.

---

## 3. Bangladesh Cyber Security & Data Privacy Guidelines

### Local Data Residency
* All citizen personal identifiable information (NID numbers, land deeds, phone numbers) is stored inside sovereign PostgreSQL partitions with Row-Level Security (`auth.uid()`).
* **Zero-Trace Cybercafé Policy**: Shared public terminal sessions are held in volatile RAM only and purged automatically upon tab closure.

---

## 4. Consumer Rights Protection Act 2009 (E-Commerce Guidelines)

### Merchant Accountability
* Every AI-generated order proposal must display clear item descriptions, prices in BDT (৳), and courier COD terms before payment confirmation.
* Fake receipt manipulation triggers instant merchant account suspension.
